data.name: Construction Simulator 4 - Pocket Edition
data.detailed_description:
Construction Simulator 4 – now also available for PC!

Collectors and fans of the series can now complete their collection on a PC.

With Construction Simulator 4, you dive into a fictional country inspired by the panoramic landscapes of Canada and explore three huge interconnected areas.

Each region features its own extensive campaign and unique challenges that you must face with your growing construction company. Look forward to many renowned vehicles and machines from brands such as Atlas, BELL, Bobcat, Bomag, CASE, Caterpillar, Kenworth, Liebherr, Mack Trucks, MAN, MEILLER Kipper, Palfinger, STILL, and the WIRTGEN GROUP, as well as CIFA, DAF, and Scania.

Countless hours of varied gameplay await you with more than 100 construction jobs across three regions, along with 80 vehicles from over 20 official license partners.

Key Features:

Over 80 detailed vehicles, construction machines, and equipment from more than 20 license partners

More than 100 varied construction jobs

Brand-new map inspired by the Canadian landscape

Realistic cockpit views

Full support for mouse and keyboard

data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German*, Spanish - Spain, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Quad Q6600 @ 2.40GHz or AMD Phenom II X3 720
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon HD 6850 1GB VRAM or Nvidia GeForce GTX 460 768MB VRAM or Intel HD 520
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 11 compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3220M@3.3Ghz | i5-3320@2.6GhZ or AMD Phenom II X4 965 | AMD FX-6100 Six-Core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon HD 7870 2GB VRAM or Nvidia GeForce GTX 660 2GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 11 compatible
